messages:
maria: Quick ask — can we produce a one-page compliance brief for CISOs: security controls, SLA summary, deploy modes, short benchmark callout. Need field-ready by EOD tomorrow. Draft in Drive: https://drive.redwood/compliance/onepager-draft

leo: I can draft the positioning bullets. Keep it concise and non-technical.

sam: Benchmark blurb (non-technical): 'Tuned hosted configs: median token latency ~110ms; dedicated pools: higher throughput and stronger isolation. Cost varies by model and optimizations.'

jamal: Inbound routing plan: tag = `compliance-brief`; assign queue = Field-AE-Compliance; notify Slack #sales-compliance. I'll stage the Intercom rule for testing.

eva: Design brief: single-column, headline + 3 tiles (Security, SLAs, Deployment Modes). Two color variants for print/web. Need EN/DE/FR strings. Please supply alt text.

doc-bot: docs: created revision v0.3 at https://docs.redwood/briefs/compliance-onepager (rev: v0.3)

maria: SLA line draft: 'Enterprise SLA options available. Dedicated tiers for isolation. Uptime options to 99.95%.'

sam: Wording tweak: avoid hard latency promises — use ranges or qualifiers.

leo: Add a tiny competitor snapshot (2 rows): SLA vs isolation capability. Keep it factual.

jamal: Pseudo-rule I'll test on staging before prod:
```
if message.contains("compliance" or "CISO" or "onepager"):
  add_tag("compliance-brief")
  assign_queue("Field-AE-Compliance")
  notify_slack("#sales-compliance", "New compliance brief lead")
```

eva: Deliverables checklist: PDF @2x, web PNG, alt text, 3 translations, CTA -> webinar signup. Add micro-benchmark footnote (non-sensitive numbers).

maria: Great. I'll finalize copy + upload final PDF by noon tomorrow and ping when live. Thanks!
